live_test_results.note_422: 422 responses are expected - test used minimal/empty bodies. Real calls with proper data should return 200.

known_issues.description: experts_router.py has prefix='/api/experts' which combines with app prefix '/api/v1' to create '/api/v1/api/experts/...' (double /api)
Some endpoints use {article_urn} as path parameter. URNs contain '/' which nginx decodes from %2F, breaking routing. Query params should be used instead.
POST /api/v1/api/experts/query returns 503 - OpenRouter AI service not available. Needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY in merlt/.env
known_issues.fix: Ensure OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set in merlt/.env and the service is reachable

known_issues.description: POST /api/v1/enrichment/live returns 500 - Likely missing DB connection or LLM service for entity extraction
known_issues.fix: Check FalkorDB/PostgreSQL connections and OpenRouter API key

known_issues.description: POST /api/v1/ingestion/validate returns 404 - Endpoint may expect path parameters or different route structure
known_issues.fix: Check if endpoint uses path params not covered by test

known_issues.description: POST /api/v1/api/experts/feedback/* returns 404 for 2 endpoints due to DOUBLE_API_PREFIX bug
known_issues.fix: Fix DOUBLE_API_PREFIX issue first (change prefix from '/api/experts' to '/experts')
